title: sagina maritima subsp. rodriguezii
intro: Sagina maritima subsp. rodriguezii, commonly known as seaside pearlwort, is a type of flowering plant in the carnation family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, making it a possible remedy for various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sagina maritima subsp. rodriguezii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
